about.heading: Who I am
about.summary: Currently enrolled in the M.Sc. Applied Computer Science programme at Hochschule Schmalkalden and eligible for Werkstudent roles. I'm a software engineer with 3.5+ years of industry experience in full-stack development, specialising in JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, microservices architecture and RESTful APIs. I've delivered production-grade systems for enterprise telecommunications and logistics platforms, with measurable improvements in performance, scalability and reliability — and I'm experienced in secure API design, database optimisation and cloud-ready deployments using Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
about.factStudyValue: M.Sc. Applied Computer Science, Hochschule Schmalkalden

skills.heading: What I work with
skills.subheading: Tools and technologies I use to design, build and ship backend systems.

bullets: Architected and maintained scalable microservices using Java 11, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL for telecom platforms serving 5M+ subscribers.
Reduced API response time from ~800ms to ~150ms by introducing Redis distributed caching and eliminating N+1 query patterns in JPA.
Built high-availability REST APIs integrated with 6+ third-party external systems, cutting integration failure points by 30%.
Implemented OAuth2 + JWT authentication with role-based access control and audit logging for secure multi-tenant access.
Containerised services with Docker and automated deployments via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, reducing release cycle time by ~25%.
Developed real-time analytics dashboards using Angular 12 and HighCharts.js, visualising KPIs for telecom operations teams.
Led production incident resolution and mentored 2 junior engineers in backend and frontend best practices.
Developed and maintained enterprise logistics and cargo revenue accounting modules in Java/Spring Boot handling high-volume financial transactions.
Reduced production issue resolution time by ~25% through systematic log analysis using Linux tools and SQL profiling.
Contributed to CI/CD improvements in Jenkins, reducing deployment friction for the team.
Built REST API endpoints and backend modules under mentorship; contributed to bug fixes and unit testing with JUnit.
Analysed production issues and supported debugging of Java-based enterprise applications for banking/IT clients.

projects.heading: Things I've built

items.title: HSM Developer Hub
items.subtitle: Community & events platform (ongoing)
items.description: An open-source, full-stack community platform for Hochschule Schmalkalden students, supporting event registration, post creation, commenting and community engagement. Building component-driven frontend features in React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, with Supabase for real-time data, auth and storage, and Prisma managing schema and migrations.

items.title: Air Quality Index Prediction
items.subtitle: KNSIT Bangalore
items.description: Built and compared multiple regression models (Linear Regression, Random Forest, Ridge/Lasso, XGBoost) to predict Air Quality Index values from environmental sensor data, including a custom Python web scraper for real-world data and a deployed frontend on Heroku for the best-performing model.
